label: audited word F1 (Tesseract vs the text the generator printed)
purpose: per-page MRC gate; read with QualityModel.loadScreen, never with QualityModel.load
polarity: higher pGood is better; loadScreen negates the weights and flips the threshold so pipeline code keeps a single polarity (predict = 1 - pGood, gate fires at pGood <= threshold)

screen.note: threshold chosen on out-of-fold predictions, so the precision/recall quoted with it are mildly optimistic

fit.split: grouped 80/20, whole base pages held out

metrics.source: held-out grouped split, scored by the shipped head

notes: head.good is the screen; the middle and bad heads are kept only for comparison and cannot separate their classes without OCR text
these weights were fitted on the training split above; the cross-validated metrics in real-train-cv.json come from per-fold models and do not measure this head
the metrics block above does measure this head, but on one 100-row grouped holdout: treat it as noisy rather than as a CV estimate
